description:
## Goal

Make Compiler2 behave as one long-lived recalculation graph: retain derived state across requests, integrate source changes through exact dependency movement, and recompute only the smallest affected reader closure. Cold and incremental compilation execution speed are primary constraints.

The direct fact engine already preserves authoritative semantic state in `World`, but the product layer creates a fresh `PullSession` for every root drive and discards its exact product generations and dependency edges afterward. RuntimeDemand also still settles a whole reachable cone from bottom. These two boundaries make locally demand-driven code behave like batch compilation at request and demand-fixpoint boundaries.

## Northstar constraints

- One semantic fact authority in `World`; one request-local product authority per root.
- One logical fact gets one key and revisions move only when aggregate content moves.
- A root product asks only for products reachable from that root.
- Fact and product movements invalidate exact recorded readers; no root, world, fact, product, or executable-inventory rediscovery pass.
- Jobs declare reads, waits, outputs, and changes. The fact-to-producer map is the only work ignition authority.
- Cycles converge through ordinary monotone reactive formulas, not batch phases or replay from bottom.
- Same values with different ownership or dependency identities do not become one cache key merely because their outputs compare equal.
- Every optimization is defended by deterministic causal work counts and byte-identical artifacts, not wall-clock thresholds.

## Signal

The permanent incremental contract uses one `Compiler2` and one root:

1. An unchanged second request performs no producer evaluation for an already settled product answer.
2. Redefining an unreachable function invalidates and evaluates no products for the root.
3. Redefining a reachable leaf changes the artifact and evaluates only the exact transitive product-reader closure.
4. Equal reproduction preserves generations and wakes nobody.
5. Cold compilation retains work-count ratchets for scheduler evaluations, product production, displacement, cache hits, recursive settlement, and demanded product population.

Representative 00420 signal at `a3a9761d1`: 2,381 scheduler completions and 9,809 product settlements; 4,094 TransportShape plus 3,901 CallableConstruction settlements are 81.5 percent of product settlements. Eight RuntimeDemand cone settlements cover up to 204 members, climb 17 rounds, and perform up to 1,068 member derivations. A debug sampling profile places roughly one quarter of captured main-thread stacks in runtime-demand production.

## Strategy

Work backward from persistent exact reuse:

1. Preserve one product session per root and deliver every relevant fact movement to dormant as well as active sessions without scanning standing state.
2. Make RuntimeDemand formulas order-independent and move ExecutableFacts to the direct fact graph.
3. Replace whole-cone RuntimeDemand replay with one ordinary reactive formula per executable and delete the bespoke cone authorities.
4. Re-measure root-scoped churn, then remove only work whose ownership and dependency evidence proves unnecessary.
5. Replace remaining drain-time wait inventories with exact edge-triggered pulls.
6. Delete proven semantic residue so the implementation and documentation name only live concepts.

## Dependency graph

```mermaid
graph LR
  M[Product work census] --> P[Persistent root product sessions]
  P --> R[Reactive RuntimeDemand]
  O[Order-independent demand] --> R
  F[ExecutableFacts is a fact] --> R
  R --> C[Root product churn audit]
  C --> T[Transport population audit]
  W[Edge-triggered waits]
  D[Semantic residue deletions]
```

## Completion

- Incremental no-op, irrelevant-edit, and reachable-edit contracts are green through production APIs.
- Cold and incremental work are change-proportional by causal counts.
- The RuntimeDemand cone, ephemeral root product memo boundary, and drain-time wait scans are gone.
- Product identity continues to encode ownership and exact dependencies.
- `northstar.html`, agent documentation, and user guides describe the implemented model and contain no stale job or publication claims.
- Full library, single-threaded fixture matrix, interp/run/build parity, determinism checks, and clippy with warnings denied pass.
- Temporary telemetry, harnesses, and compatibility affordances are removed before their owning tickets close.
title: Compiler2: become a long-lived change-proportional recalculator
